subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu group chat: slash commands like /new, /status, and /model do not work and may lose message content

question: Should Feishu text slash commands with no explicit command allowlist inherit already-admitted Feishu sender access, or should the shared command-gating helper treat all-unconfigured access-group authorizers as allowed across channels?
rationale: Both shapes can fix the user symptom, but they define different command-authorization security boundaries and upgrade behavior for Feishu versus all channels using the shared helper.

options.title: Prefer Feishu-scoped inheritance
options.body: Authorize Feishu text slash commands for senders already admitted by Feishu DM/group policy when no Feishu command allowlist is configured, while preserving explicit allowlist denial and adding Feishu DM/group proof.

options.title: Approve shared helper change
options.body: Change `resolveCommandAuthorizedFromAuthorizers` globally so all-unconfigured access-group command authorizers are allowed, with cross-channel security and compatibility tests.

options.title: Keep fail-closed default
options.body: Require explicit command allowlists for Feishu control commands and document the operator action instead of changing runtime defaults.

recommendation.title: Prefer Feishu-scoped inheritance
recommendation.body: Authorize Feishu text slash commands for senders already admitted by Feishu DM/group policy when no Feishu command allowlist is configured, while preserving explicit allowlist denial and adding Feishu DM/group proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for both the shared command gate and current Feishu/channel context code is on steipete-authored commits.
